description: phpMyFAQ versions before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated editors to manipulate search index documents by supplying arbitrary solutionId values to the /admin/api/faq/update endpoint. In deployments using Elasticsearch or OpenSearch, category-restricted editors can remove published FAQs from search results, overwrite other FAQs' search documents, or insert entries that remain searchable even after being unpublished.
